Rae (CS): Hi all 
Weekly "Tailwatch" for SummitAI — focusing on p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs non-stream. Usage steady, embed spend up ~8%, saw two short p99 spikes on /completion non-stream yesterday. Dropping compact table + quick notes.

Ibrahim (SRE): thanks. paste the numbers and any quick root-cause flags.

Rae (CS): rolling 7d, units ms/err%/daily reqs.

```
route       model     mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat       t6-pro    streaming    210  690  0.22  20k
/chat       t6-pro    non-stream   390 1200 0.95   2.6k
/completion gpt-slim  sync         640 1900 2.1    4.8k
/embed      pico      streaming     50  135 0.03  65k
/rerank     llama2    non-stream   980 2600 3.2    840
```

Noemi (Solutions): notes: streaming reduces p95 ~45% on /chat; p99 also tighter. Rerank tail appears strongly correlated with very large batch token sizes and occasional OOMs on the dedicated pool.

Ibrahim (SRE): confirmed 3 OOMs between 02:30-03:00 UTC yesterday on their dedicated nodes. We applied a temporary batch cap of 1k tokens last night which reduced OOMs.

Evan (Customer): we had a retry storm from a background job at 15:18 UTC that resulted in a visible slowdown for a subset of users. Only ~10 sessions impacted but it looks bad in UI.

Noemi (Solutions): recommendations: 
- Default stream=true for /chat in staging (p95/p99 benefit).
- Add client jitter + exponential backoff to avoid retry amplification.
- Cap rerank batch tokens to 2k and enable early-exit heuristics for extreme lengths.

Rae (CS): Action items:
- Ibrahim: collect OOM traces and attach to CH-2475-01 by EOD (@Ibrahim).
- Noemi: draft a 1-pager for the customer on streaming benefits + code snippet by Tue.
- Rae: send embed spend cap options and renewal prep notes to Evan.

SystemBot: Incident CH-2475-01 created: "SummitAI dedicated pool OOMs & rerank tail" assigned to Ibrahim.

Noemi (Solutions): quick curl example to enable streaming for chat:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{\"route\":\"/chat\",\"model\":\"t6-pro\",\"stream\":true}'
```

Evan (Customer): I'll flip streaming in staging tonight and run the p99 synthetic. Please include suggested $ caps for embed.

Rae (CS): noted 
Next sync Friday 9am PT. Thanks everyone!
